datasets.name: HR-GLDD dataset
datasets.verbatim: The HR-GLDD dataset [47] contains five rainfall-triggered and five earthquake-triggered multiple landslide events that occurred in varying geomorphological and topographical regions.

datasets.name: Landslide4Sense dataset
datasets.verbatim: The Landslide4Sense dataset is the multi-source landslide benchmark data with a diversity of landslide triggers, topography, and land cover [48].

datasets.name: Bijie Landslide Dataset
datasets.source: photogrammetry and computer vision group of Wuhan University [49]
datasets.verbatim: The Bijie Landslide Dataset was released by the photogrammetry and computer vision group of Wuhan University [49].

methods.name: GMNet (Global information extraction and multi-scale feature fusion segmentation network)
methods.summary: GMNet is a semantic segmentation network that uses a multi-branch encoder (transformer and CNN) for global information extraction, a Semantic Information Enhancement (SIE) module to bridge the semantic gap between low-level and high-level features, and a Multi-scale Feature Fusion (MFF) module to handle varying landslide scales.

availability.author_statement: Data will be made available on request.

reproducibility_assessment: The landslide inventory datasets are mentioned but not linked, and the custom code for the GMNet method is not provided or linked.
